about: A Go library for handling money amounts and formatting them for each country and language.

prs.title: Norwegian prices format as Norwegian again
prs.broken: After a locale data update, amounts for Norwegian Bokmål came out in English style, like NOK 1,234.56 instead of 1 234,56 kr.
prs.changed: The library again knows that Bokmål uses the general Norwegian formatting rules, as it did in the previous release.
prs.matters: Shops and apps showing prices to Norwegian users get the right format back.

prs.title: US dollars no longer look like pesos in Mexican Spanish
prs.broken: In Mexican Spanish and a few other locales, US dollars and the local currency both showed as $, so a dollar price read as pesos.
prs.changed: Any locale whose own currency also uses $ now shows US dollars as US$.
prs.matters: Shoppers can tell which currency a price is in.
